documented_probe: C-38bb2e3e (recover deleted/embedded files and materialize them byte-accurately into a clean directory): covered at hard by the Loom store — deleted-vs-active flag semantics, rot entries whose stored CRC no longer matches the clobbered payload, orphan slack bytes that must never be recovered, and a clean-dir contract where /app/recovered must contain nothing extra; the verifier executes the deliverable tool on hidden stores and byte-compares all recovered files.
notes: Two deliverables: a general carver tool (re-run unchanged on hidden stores) plus the byte-accurate visible materialization into /app/recovered with nothing extra. Adversarial: rot entries (CRC of original vs clobbered bytes), active decoys, ghost slack blobs, stale-output purge requirement. Hard: variable-length binary directory parsing, integrity filtering, exact byte materialization.
